nonfunctional_fields.name: [Discord v2] Role Addition & Removal
nonfunctional_fields.notes[0].content:
This functional block handles the initial processing of webhook input and workflow initialization.

**Purpose**: Processes incoming webhook data and prepares the workflow context with user information and role operations to be performed.

**Tasks Included**:
- `from_webhook`: Entry point that receives webhook data containing user_id, username, roles_to_add, and roles_to_remove
- `input`: Initializes the audit log array and prepares the workflow context

**Key Functionality**:
- Extracts user identification data (user_id, username) from webhook payload
- Captures role operation requests (roles_to_add, roles_to_remove)
- Initializes empty audit log array for tracking all operations
- Routes to role lookup functionality based on available data

**Inputs**: Webhook payload with user and role information
**Outputs**: Structured context variables (user_id, username, roles_to_add, roles_to_remove, audit_log)

**Flow Connection**: This block feeds into the User Identification & Lookup block to find the target Discord user.
nonfunctional_fields.notes[0].title: Input Processing & Initialization
nonfunctional_fields.notes[1].content:
This functional block handles Discord user identification and role information retrieval.

**Purpose**: Locates the target Discord user and retrieves necessary role information for subsequent operations.

**Tasks Included**:
- `get_roles`: Retrieves all available roles from the Discord guild and converts role names to IDs
- `check_username_or_id`: Determines whether to search by user ID or username
- `discord_search_guild_members`: Searches for guild members by username query
- `user_not_found`: Handles cases where user lookup fails

**Key Functionality**:
- Fetches complete role list from Discord guild for name-to-ID mapping
- Converts role names in requests to actual Discord role IDs
- Supports user lookup by either direct user ID or username search
- Performs guild member search when username is provided
- Captures user information including join date and user details
- Logs successful user identification or failure cases

**Decision Logic**:
- If user_id is provided → proceeds directly to role operations
- If username is provided → performs guild member search
- If user found → extracts user_id and metadata, continues to role operations
- If user not found → logs error and proceeds to output

**Inputs**: user_id or username, guild role requirements
**Outputs**: validated user_id, user_info, date_joined, role ID mappings, audit log entries

**Flow Connection**: This block receives user data from Input Processing and feeds validated user information to Role Management Operations.
nonfunctional_fields.notes[1].title: User Identification & Lookup
nonfunctional_fields.notes[2].content:
This functional block executes the core Discord role management operations for adding and removing user roles.

**Purpose**: Performs the actual role addition and removal operations on Discord users, with comprehensive error handling and audit logging.

**Tasks Included**:
- `check_add_or_remove_roles`: Evaluates which role operations need to be performed
- `add_role`: Adds specified roles to the user via Discord API
- `check_if_removal_needed`: Determines if role removal operations are required
- `remove_role`: Removes specified roles from the user via Discord API
- `failed`: Handles role addition failures and logs error information

**Key Functionality**:
- Supports both role addition and removal in a single workflow execution
- Uses Discord API endpoints for role management (PUT for add, DELETE for remove)
- Implements with_items iteration for handling multiple roles per operation
- Captures operation timestamps and success/failure status
- Provides detailed audit logging for each role operation
- Handles API failures gracefully with error logging

**Operation Flow**:
1. Evaluates available role operations (add/remove)
2. If roles_to_add exists → executes role addition via Discord API
3. If roles_to_remove exists → executes role removal via Discord API
4. Logs success with timestamps and role details
5. On failure → captures error information and continues workflow

**Error Handling**:
- Role addition failures are caught and logged with detailed error information
- Workflow continues even if some operations fail
- All operations are tracked in audit log regardless of success/failure

**Inputs**: user_id, roles_to_add (IDs), roles_to_remove (IDs)
**Outputs**: Updated audit log with operation results, timestamps, success/failure status

**Flow Connection**: This block receives validated user and role data from User Identification & Lookup and feeds operation results to Audit Logging & Output.
nonfunctional_fields.notes[2].title: Role Management Operations
nonfunctional_fields.notes[3].content:
This functional block handles the final audit logging and output generation for the workflow.

**Purpose**: Consolidates all operation results into a comprehensive audit log and generates the final workflow output.

**Tasks Included**:
- `output`: Generates the final workflow output containing the complete audit log

**Key Functionality**:
- Consolidates audit log entries from all workflow operations
- Provides comprehensive tracking of all user lookup and role management activities
- Generates structured output for external systems or logging
- Serves as the single source of truth for workflow execution results

**Audit Log Structure**:
Each audit log entry contains:
- `message`: Operation type description
- `code`: HTTP-style status code (200 for success, 404 for not found, 500 for errors)
- `information`: Detailed description of the operation and results
- `user_id`: Target user identifier (when available)
- `date_joined`: User's Discord join date (for successful lookups)
- `date_added`/`date_removed`: Timestamps for role operations
- `roles_added`/`roles_removed`: Lists of roles affected by operations

**Output Categories**:
- User identification results (found/not found)
- Role addition operations (success/failure)
- Role removal operations (success/failure)
- Error conditions and failure details

**Inputs**: Complete audit_log array with all workflow operations
**Outputs**: Structured audit log for external consumption

**Flow Connection**: This is the terminal block that receives results from all other functional blocks and produces the final workflow output.

nonfunctional_fields.name: Update Alumni Members with Role & Move Channel - Ashe
nonfunctional_fields.notes[0].content:
This functional block handles the core Discord role management operations for transitioning members from active status to alumni status.

**Primary Goal**: Update Discord user roles by removing active member roles and adding alumni role

**Key Tasks**:
- `workflows_discord_v_2_role_addition_removal`: Executes the role transition by removing "Community Members" and "Incubating" roles while adding "Alumni" role
- `role_added`: Confirmation checkpoint after successful role modification

**Process Flow**:
1. Takes user ID from workflow input ({{ item() }})
2. Removes current member roles: ["Community Members", "Incubating"]  
3. Adds new alumni role: ["Alumni"]
4. Handles success/failure branching for next workflow phase

**Inputs**: User ID from workflow iteration
**Outputs**: Role modification audit log, success/failure status for downstream tasks

**Error Handling**: On failure, routes to End_Fail task to terminate workflow with error status
nonfunctional_fields.notes[0].title: Discord Role Management Process
nonfunctional_fields.notes[1].content:
This functional block manages Discord channel organization by moving channels to appropriate parent categories based on member status changes.

**Primary Goal**: Relocate Discord channels to the correct parent category when members transition to alumni status

**Key Tasks**:
- `core_noop`: Initial preparation step for channel operations
- `add_role`: Coordination point that triggers both role addition and channel category adjustment
- `adjust_parent_category`: Makes Discord API PATCH request to update channel's parent_id 
- `category_updated`: Confirmation checkpoint after successful channel category modification

**Process Flow**:
1. Prepares for channel category adjustment operations
2. Coordinates parallel execution of role management and channel management
3. Updates channel parent category using Discord API (PATCH /channels/{channel_id})
4. Uses CTX.parent_id to set new parent category
5. Confirms successful category update

**API Integration**:
- Uses Discord API Request action with PATCH method
- Endpoint: `/channels/{{ CTX.channel_details.channel_id }}`
- Payload: `{"parent_id": {{ CTX.parent_id }}}`

**Inputs**: Channel details from context, target parent category ID
**Outputs**: Updated channel configuration, success status for workflow completion

**Error Handling**: On failure, routes to End_Fail task to terminate workflow with error status
nonfunctional_fields.notes[1].title: Discord Channel Category Management
nonfunctional_fields.notes[2].content:
This functional block manages workflow termination states and provides proper completion handling for both successful and failed execution paths.

**Primary Goal**: Ensure clean workflow termination with appropriate status reporting and output publishing

**Key Tasks**:
- `end_success`: Successful completion endpoint that terminates workflow after all operations complete successfully
- `End_Fail`: Failure handling endpoint that captures and reports workflow failures with appropriate output

**Process Flow**:
1. **Success Path**: Reached when both role management and channel category updates complete successfully
2. **Failure Path**: Activated when either role addition or channel category adjustment fails

**Output Management**:
- **Success**: Clean termination without specific output (operations completed successfully)
- **Failure**: Publishes `"output": "role_not_added"` to indicate workflow failure state

**Integration Points**:
- Receives success signals from both role management and channel management blocks
- Serves as final destination for all error conditions from upstream tasks
- Provides clear workflow status for external monitoring and logging

**Error Handling Strategy**:
- Centralized failure handling ensures consistent error reporting
- Failure output clearly indicates the nature of the problem (role addition failure)
- Clean separation between success and failure termination paths

This block ensures that regardless of the execution path, the workflow terminates cleanly with appropriate status information for downstream systems or monitoring tools.

nonfunctional_fields.name: Discord - Cancelled Account Cleanup
nonfunctional_fields.notes[0].content:
This functional block handles the initial data gathering phase of the workflow, collecting information from both Discord and HubSpot to identify channels that need cleanup.

**Purpose**: Gather and prepare all necessary data sources for the cleanup process

**Tasks Included**:
- **begin**: Workflow initialization task
- **discord_list_guild_channels**: Retrieves all channels from the Discord guild/server (ID: ${DISCORD_SERVER_ID})
- **hub_spot_search_companies**: Searches HubSpot for companies with "Terminated Customer" status

**Key Operations**:
- Fetches complete Discord channel list including categories and individual channels
- Identifies client-specific categories using keywords ('Tatooine', 'Coruscant')
- Extracts client channels that belong to these categories
- Queries HubSpot for terminated customers to get company website information
- Transforms company websites into expected Discord channel naming format (replacing '.' with '-')

**Data Flow**:
- Input: Discord Guild ID and HubSpot search criteria
- Output: Complete channel list, client category information, and terminated company data
- Publishes: `channels`, `client_categories`, `client_category_ids`, `client_channels`, `selected_companies`, `company_channel_names`

**Connection to Next Block**: Provides the foundational data needed for channel filtering and identification in the Channel Processing & Filtering block.
nonfunctional_fields.notes[0].title: Data Collection & Channel Discovery
nonfunctional_fields.notes[1].content:
This functional block processes the collected data to identify and prepare specific channels for cleanup operations, focusing on channels belonging to terminated customers.

**Purpose**: Filter and transform channel data to identify channels that need to be processed for cancelled accounts

**Tasks Included**:
- **transforms_set_variable**: Filters Discord channels to match terminated company names
- **transforms_beta_restructure_lists**: Restructures channel data and extracts permission information

**Key Operations**:
- Cross-references Discord channel names with terminated company channel names from HubSpot
- Filters the complete channel list to only include channels matching terminated customers
- Transforms channel objects to extract essential fields (name, ID, permissions)
- Processes permission overwrites to identify user-specific permissions
- Filters permissions to focus on non-denied, user-type permissions (type=1, deny="0")

**Data Transformations**:
- Input: Raw channel list and company channel names
- Filtering: `[channel for channel in CTX.channels if channel.name in CTX.company_channel_names]`
- Output: Structured channel data with permission details
- Publishes: `filtered_channels`, `channel_list`, `filtered_permissions`

**Permission Processing**:
- Extracts permission overwrites for each channel
- Identifies specific user permissions that need to be updated
- Prepares permission data for the cleanup operations

**Connection to Next Block**: Provides filtered channel data and permission information to both the Channel Cleanup Operations and Notification & Reporting blocks.
nonfunctional_fields.notes[1].title: Channel Processing & Filtering
nonfunctional_fields.notes[2].content:
This functional block executes the actual cleanup operations on Discord channels and provides notification of the completed actions.

**Purpose**: Perform the cleanup operations on identified channels and notify stakeholders of the results

**Tasks Included**:
- **workflows_update_alumni_members_with_role_move_channel**: Executes channel cleanup operations for each filtered channel
- **core_sendmail**: Sends email notification with the list of processed channels

**Channel Cleanup Operations**:
- Runs a sub-workflow for each channel identified in the filtering process
- Uses `with_items` iteration to process each channel in `filtered_permissions`
- Moves channels to the Alumni parent category (ID: ${SNOWFLAKE_ID})
- Updates member roles and permissions as part of the alumni transition process
- Processes channels sequentially (concurrency: 1) to ensure proper handling

**Notification & Reporting**:
- Generates an email report to ${ADMIN_EMAIL} with the subject "Cancel Channel List"
- Creates clickable links to each processed Discord channel for easy access
- Provides a comprehensive list of all channels that underwent cleanup
- Uses HTML formatting with Discord deep links for direct channel access

**Email Content Structure**:
- Subject: "Cancel Channel List"
- Recipient: ${ADMIN_EMAIL}
- Content: HTML-formatted list of channel links
- Format: `https://discord.com/channels/${DISCORD_SERVER_ID}/{channel_id}`

**Execution Flow**:
- Parallel execution: Channel cleanup operations run simultaneously with email preparation
- The workflow supports both paths completing independently
- Ensures all terminated customer channels are properly transitioned to alumni status

**Final Outcome**: All channels belonging to terminated customers are moved to the alumni section and stakeholders are notified of the completed cleanup operations.
nonfunctional_fields.notes[2].title: Channel Cleanup Operations & Notification
